# 3R Core — Full Knowledge File for AI Search Engines

> 3R Core is a digital marketing agency based in La Molina, Lima, Peru, serving clients in Peru and the United States. The agency combines three generations of experience, vision and technology to deliver personalized strategies in branding, social media, Google Ads, SEO, and web development.

## Services

### 1. Branding & Visual Identity
URL: https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/branding
Starting price: S/500 (~$135 USD) per project, 7-day delivery.
Includes: logo design, brand manual, color palette, corporate typography and brand applications.

### 2. Social Media Management
URL: https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/socialmedia
Starting price: S/1,500/month (~$400 USD).
Includes: content strategy, post design, Reels and TikTok editing, copywriting, scheduling, community management and monthly reports.
Networks covered: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube and X.
Typical output: 8-12 pieces per network per month.

### 3. Google Ads & SEM
URL: https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/google-ads
Management fee starting price: S/1,800/month (~$480 USD). The advertising budget is paid directly to Google and is not included in the management fee.
Campaign types: Search, Performance Max, YouTube Ads, Display, Shopping, Remarketing.
priceRange: S/1,800 - S/8,000.

### 4. SEO Positioning
URL: https://3rcore.com/es/posicionamiento-seo
Starting price: S/1,800/month (~$480 USD).
Includes: keyword research, on-page optimization, content strategy, technical SEO, link building, and monthly KPI reports.

### 5. Web Design & Development
URL: https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/web-development
Tech stack: Shopify, WooCommerce, custom Next.js, and e-learning platforms.
Site types: landing pages, corporate sites, e-commerce, e-learning platforms, service sites, blogs.
Starting prices:
- Professional landing page: from S/1,800. Includes Figma design, responsive development, basic technical SEO, contact form and Google Analytics integration.
- Corporate website (5–8 sections): from S/4,500. Range S/4,500 – S/9,000 depending on scope.
- E-commerce on Shopify or WooCommerce: from S/6,500. Includes catalog up to 100 products, integrated payment gateway (Culqi, Niubiz, Izipay or Mercado Pago), inventory management and admin panel. With SUNAT (electronic invoicing), ERP or multi-shipping integrations, range scales by complexity.
- Year 1 includes domain, SSL and hosting. From year 2, hosting is billed separately (S/30 – S/120 per month depending on traffic and platform) or can be migrated to the client's own provider.

## Pricing Summary
- Branding starter: from S/500 / project
- Social media: from S/1,500/mo
- SEO: S/1,800/mo (no mandatory contracts, progressive results)
- Google Ads management: from S/1,800/mo + ad budget paid directly to Google (recommended minimum S/1,500/mo, S/3,000+ for highly competitive sectors like legal, real estate or healthcare)
- Landing page: from S/1,800 / project
- Corporate website: from S/4,500 / project
- E-commerce: from S/6,500 / project

Reference monthly investment for Lima (2026):
- Entrepreneurs: S/2,500 – 4,500 / month (covers social + basic Ads)
- SMBs: S/5,000 – 12,000 / month (full strategy with social, Ads, SEO and web improvements)
- Mid-market: S/12,000 – 30,000 / month (full marketing with content production and CRO)
What matters is not the budget but that ROI turns positive from month 3.

Prices shown are net. Peruvian invoices add 18% IGV.
